opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant £100,000; usual grant range £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research. Project must be a strategic institutional priority coordinated by the university Development Office.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, improve research infrastructure, and occasionally improve access/research libraries or public engagement with science.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Museums and galleries operated by a registered charity or local authority, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally for refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education/learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations (registered charity or local authority) managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance that are open to the public, with sites listed at Grade I/II*/Scheduled Monument (or equivalents in Scotland and Northern Ireland).
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Libraries and archives operated by a registered charity or local authority, accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme, open to the public, holding a permanent collection of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections with a focus on public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Performing arts organisations operated by a registered charity or local authority, focused on professional performance, able to make a case for the significance of their education work within the sector.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve training and education facilities of performing arts organisations, generally building/refurbishment and occasionally specialist equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations (registered charity, local authority or university) displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance, accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally for refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education/learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities working with disability (with at least a 'Good' regulator rating if applicable). Projects must include capital costs of at least £50,000 and a capital funding shortfall of at least £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to help people with disabilities live more independently, particularly projects focused on training, employment and supported housing, including transition from children's to adults' services.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities working in mental health (with at least a 'Good' regulator rating if applicable). Projects must include capital costs of at least £50,000 and a capital funding shortfall of at least £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards projects in mental health, with an emphasis on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities providing care and services for older people (with at least a 'Good' CQC rating if applicable). Projects must include capital costs of at least £50,000 and a capital funding shortfall of at least £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS providing excellent care to patients and their families (with at least a 'Good' regulator rating if applicable). Projects must include capital costs of at least £50,000 and a capital funding shortfall of at least £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charities or local authorities operating special schools and colleges (with at least a 'Good' regulator rating if applicable). Projects must include capital costs of at least £50,000 and a capital funding shortfall of at least £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to support special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, helping pupils at secondary level develop skills for employment or independent living.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant £15,000; maximum grant £100,000; usual range £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: High-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK with at least two years of exam results and a 'Good' or above Ofsted/Estyn/HMIE/ETI rating. Projects must cost at least £25,000 and focus on teaching of GCSE/A-Level subjects requiring specialist spaces and equipment.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to help high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges create and improve specialist teaching facilities for GCSE and A-Level subjects (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts). One-stage application process. The 2026 funding round is closed; the next round is expected in spring 2027.
